style.view: Top-down orthographic view looking straight down, map view, no perspective, not isometric.
style.medium: Stylized hand-painted strategy-game map asset, painterly but clean, soft edges, readable silhouette, not photoreal, not 3D render.
style.world: Post-apocalyptic wasteland after a machine invasion: ash, scorch, corrosion, frost, permanent overcast.
style.palette: Cold desaturated palette: blue-grey, slate, charcoal, wet stone, bone, and dark sea-green for anything living. Low saturation, no warm browns, no orange, no gold.
style.light: Cold overcast light from directly above, flat and blue-tinted, no long cast shadow, at most a faint contact shadow.
style.isolation: ONE object only, centered, filling about 80% of the frame, no ground plane, no other objects, no people, no text, no watermark, no frame.

backgrounds.chroma: The background is a perfectly flat, solid, pure green #00FF00 with no gradient and no texture.

style.view: Top-down orthographic view looking straight down at flat ground, map view, no perspective, no horizon.
style.medium: Seamless tileable ground texture for a strategy-game map, even detail across the whole frame, no focal object, no vignette.
style.world: Post-apocalyptic wasteland after a machine invasion, under permanent overcast.
style.palette: Cold desaturated blue-grey tones, low contrast, low saturation, no warm browns.
style.light: Flat cold overcast light from directly above, no directional shadows.
style.isolation: Fill the entire frame edge to edge with the surface, no objects, no text, no watermark, no border.
